name: follow-button
title: Follow button
description: Follow, Following and Requested in one button: optimistic, with a follower count, a clear way to unfollow and a rollback message when the request fails.
docs: Controlled: keep status and count in state and update both in onFollow and onUnfollow before they resolve. The button answers at once and rolls back with a message if the promise rejects; presses are ignored while a request is pending. Resolve onFollow with "requested" when the account needs approval, or pass isPrivate to ask for it up front; unfollowing a private account asks once. defaultStatus leaves the status to the button, and the count then stays as given for that starting status and moves with the button. The error line is wider than the button and widens the control with it, so where you right-align the button pass className="items-end" (or sm:items-end) and it keeps its right edge when a request fails. The accessible name stays "Follow <name>" and aria-pressed carries the state, while the visible word changes to Following or Requested.
